purpose: ONS subnational dwelling stock by tenure (SPREE) for English local authorities, 2022 and 2024: owned outright, owned with a mortgage, private rented, social rented and total dwellings. Consumed by the census tenure share drift (uk_runtime.tenure_drift, microcosm#1123): dwellings move the census tenure shares, never their levels.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
